title: Bruce Borden - M/I Homes
summary: Bruce has been the M/I Homes National Customer Experience Manager for 20 years, and has been in the home building industry for over 30 years. Happily married and a proud father, Bruce enjoys outdoor activities and home improvement projects, and has never met someone he didn't like.
